name: Street Canyon
desc: A true two-point-perspective street canyon crabbing forward between towers — blocks converge on one vanishing point while their end walls converge on a second far off-frame, lit windows scatter across the facades, and a raking sun azimuth crawls from wall to wall over minutes.

energy.doc: window glow + camera drift + horizon bloom amplitude

scale.doc: canyon width + tower height vs frame (2.2 = cavernous walls of city)

density.doc: how many blocks recede into depth

speed.doc: rate the camera crabs down the canyon

hue.doc: horizon/lit-window hue; the sky rides 200 degrees above it

yaw.doc: camera yaw off the street axis — 0 collapses toward one-point, 1 swings both vanishing points wide

style.doc: aesthetic: modelled dusk canyon / hard monochrome chiaroscuro / cyan schematic linework / hatched paper plate / false-colour thermal

seed.doc: block heights, depths, gaps and window pattern
